01 About the gym

A real gym, in a real neighbourhood.

Arnold Gym sits on the ground floor of Raj Apartment on Kamachha Road, a couple of minutes from Kamachha Mandir in Bhelupur. It is a working, old-school kind of floor — plates stacked where you can reach them, benches always in use, mirrors on the walls and regulars who know each other's names.

No noise, no gimmicks. Just the equipment you need for serious strength work, two training batches a day, and a room full of people getting it done. Whether you are touching a barbell for the first time or adding plates to your bench, the routine is the same: show up, put in the work, come back tomorrow.

On the ground floor of Raj Apartment, Kamachha Road, Maharana Pratap Colony, Gurubagh, Bhelupur, Varanasi 221010 — right near Kamachha Mandir. Use the map above for turn-by-turn directions.

Monthly ₹600, three months ₹1,200, six months ₹1,800 and yearly ₹3,500, plus a one-time ₹200 admission fee. There's also a ₹2,500 one-year special offer on the gym's poster. WhatsApp us and we'll confirm what's running right now.
